scientific_integrity: The finite domain is exhaustive because every loop for odd k>=3 contains a prime p<=k and trajectories from such primes stay within 2..2k+2. The packaged checker enumerates every odd k in the stated range and every prime start p<=k exactly.
scientific_limitations: Finite verification over odd parameters 3<=k<=20735 only. It does not prove unboundedness of the loop count and does not establish that k=20735 is the first parameter among all positive integers with 36 loops. Even k>5000 were not enumerated.
title: Thirty-six distinct loops for Das's map at \(k=20735\)
